artifacts.how: agy changelog > internal/cli/testdata/changelog_reference.txt, then update the three constants in internal/cli/changelog_data_test.go (byte length, line count, sha256) and regenerate this lock
re-record the request body through the cycle-274 capture wrapper (cmd/agy + devutils/agyproxy) against the new binary, then rebuild internal/agyprompt/sections/*.txt from it
re-recorded alongside capture_1.4.4.txt in the same proxy run; it carries the os_version / workspaces / subagents / skills inputs Build() is fed
agy -p='x' --output-format stream-json and collect the init.tools array; repeat from three working directories as the cycle-275 test does

capture a streamGenerateContent body (cmd/agy wrapper or a CLOUD_CODE_URL mock) and extract request.tools[0].functionDeclarations; it must stay twelve, in the captured order, with the same required fields

run the real 1.4.4 TUI with CLOUD_CODE_URL pointed at a mock that answers the first streamGenerateContent with one functionCall, then read functionResponse.response.output in the follow-up request; redo for read_file (whole/range/empty), write_file (create/refusal/append) and edit_file (single/multi-line)

run the real 1.4.4 TUI in a workspace with .agents/agents/<name>.md and --agent <name>; answer the first streamGenerateContent with a CLOUD_CODE_URL mock, then extract request.tools[*].functionDeclarations. It must stay seven, in order, and keep toolSummary/toolAction required.

extract the uncompressed FileDescriptorProto for google/gca/aicode/v1main/remote_agent_proxy.proto from the agy binary (see out/local-macos/protos/README.md) and emit one <RPC>\t<Request>\t<Response> line per method; TestReferenceRPCMethodsMatchFixture pins the order
decode the FileDescriptorProto at the offset named in out/local-macos/protos/README.md with descriptor_pb2 and print it with text_format; the offset moves on every agy release
same procedure as remote_agent_proxy_1.4.4.txt, for third_party/jetski/remote_agent_proxy_pb/remote_agent_proxy.proto (package exa.remote_agent_proxy_pb)
